facts.fact: StackAdapt announced on September 30, 2026 that it has been named a Shopify Certified Technology Partner (vendor's own announcement).
facts.quote: today announced it has been named a Shopify Certified Technology Partner, recognizing StackAdapt as a trusted technology partner for Shopify merchants.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, the certification follows a technical review process that evaluates partner quality, security, and overall merchant experience.
facts.quote: The certification follows a technical review process that evaluates partner quality, security, and overall merchant experience.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, its Shopify integration brings purchase history, cart activity, and customer events into advertising strategy.
facts.quote: including purchase history, cart activity, and customer events.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, the Shopify integration enables merchants to streamline pixel onboarding, capture customer events, and activate first-party commerce data for retargeting and lookalike audiences.
facts.quote: enabling merchants to streamline pixel onboarding, capture customer events, and activate first-party commerce data for retargeting and lookalike audiences.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, Shopify-connected audiences can be refreshed dynamically to keep campaigns aligned with the latest customer behavior.
facts.quote: Audiences can be refreshed dynamically, helping marketers reduce manual work while keeping campaigns aligned with the latest customer behavior.
